headline: Uzbekistan Forecasts 7–7.5% Economic Growth for 2027 with Inflation Target at 5%
summary: Uzbekistan projects economic growth of 7 to 7.5% in 2027, with annual inflation expected to decline to 5% in the second half of the year under a price-stability monetary framework.
why: Macroeconomic growth targets and inflation forecasts provide critical visibility for foreign investors evaluating frontier emerging markets in Central Asia.

impacts.name: Uzbekistan
impacts.why: Strong GDP growth projections indicate positive economic momentum.
